zh: 德州农工大学（Texas A&M University）成立于1876年，是美国著名的公立研究型大学。学校位于德克萨斯州大学城，其前身为德州农业与机械学院，后来发展成为一所综合性大学。Texas A&M以其在工程、农业、海洋科学、航空航天等领域的卓越研究而著称，是美国大学协会（AAU）的成员之一。
en: Texas A&M University was founded in 1876 and is a famous public research university in the United States. Located in College Station

address.zh: the university originated as the Agricultural and Mechanical College of Texas and later developed into a comprehensive university. Texas A&M is renowned for its卓越研究 in engineering
